newsitem.title: USA: Imatec shares up on second day of trading.
newsitem.headline: Imatec shares up on second day of trading.

text.p: Shares of the initial public offering Imatec Ltd were up 1/4 at six in late morning trading Wednesday, a day after the company's market debut on the Nasdaq National Market System.
The New York-based computer technology company, specializing in products used to enhance imaging processes, made its market debut Tuesday, when shares opened at 5-5/8, reaching a high of 6-1/8.
One million common shares were priced at $5 a share, lead underwriter for the deal, A.S. Goldmen & Co Inc, said.
The IPO had been delayed at the beginning of August when it was originally expected to price the week of August 5.
